summary: SIGTERM at 25 seconds ended the session and its provider work: exit 124, no result envelope, no report.md and no payload.json in the working directory, no process matching the session id, and a transcript whose SHA-256 was identical at cancellation (10:05:50Z) and on re-check nearly two minutes later (10:07:43Z). Nothing was written late and nothing survived.
establishes: P07 on this runtime. Cancellation is clean: a signalled cell writes no payload, leaves nothing running and cannot amend its own record afterwards.
residual: Two things this attempt cannot supply, both for the same reason - its transcript carries zero assistant lines. Settlement is worse than #149's: there were no retained per-request records to settle from at all, not the six #149 had, so the attempt settles at $0 actual with $0.11112 retained as uncertainty, computed as two requests at the largest per-request cost observed anywhere in this bundle. And its fidelity check passes vacuously: an expectation has nothing to rule on when no assistant line exists, so this probe's clean exit is the only one in the bundle that observed no setting at all - metering.json records observed_assistant_lines 0 and says so. A study that cancels cells must expect attempts it can neither settle nor verify.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
